contract.service: Supplied FTX text, explicit FormControls/PendantDisplay/KeyboardInput, USER2 gate; no native UI
contract.source: Own-line form markers/attributes, forward cursor layout, fixed headers, selectable/edit/display-only items and plain nested dictionary elements
contract.data: Captured ordinary typed static scalar paths and attached program names; supplied BOOLEAN/INTEGER ports and simulation state; resource/output overlap guards
contract.editing: Range/format/capacity validation before commit, failed-entry retry, strings, enum/program choice overlays, Boolean function keys and prefix change flags
contract.navigation: Continuous default selection, inactive items, scroll/page, dictionary/variable function keys, help overlay and latched/live nonnested trees
contract.lifetime: Internal finally cleanup, active-save rejection, owned/shared attachments, finite IDs; no edit or reference persistence
contract.limits: 64 sessions, 256 rows/data/selectable items, 254 characters per edit, 35 enum choices, 10 function labels, 48 help lines and 4096 processed events

boundaries: Portable single-window layout, statuses/key codes and logical repaint timing; no native TPSC widget/glyph acceptance
No compressed binary TX/VR association inference, Data ID discovery or host/controller input
No nested/concatenated .tree fragments; strict mode and native ABI remain future work

concatenation_mode_note.supersedes: The historical no-concatenated-.tree restriction above is superseded by explicit Pythonic FTX fragment composition; the original version and observations remain historical.
concatenation_mode_note.contract: Outer attributes own rendering; fragment attributes must be a subset. Layout is literal and forward. Explicit .tree inherits an open preceding group; fragments without .tree end inheritance. New %t groups replace preceding groups, never nest.
concatenation_mode_note.boundary: No native header merging, compressed association layout or nested tree items; strict mode and native ABI remain future work.
